title: taac Site
description: The deployment: which trips it serves and who may see them.

access.description: Who sees the site: everyone, or people signed in with GitHub.

source.description: Where the trip files live, so the site can link each entry to its line.

vaults.description: Personal `KeePass` (`.kdbx`) vaults, keyed by vault id (e.g. `alex`).

Text.description:
Text shown in the interface: one string for every language, or one per
language (`{ en: …, ru: … }`), falling back to English, then the first.

path.description: Trip file or directory, relative to the site file.

public.description: On a `github` site: open to everyone, signed in or not.

oneOf.description:
Signing in with GitHub is required; a trip shows to its members (by
their `github`), to its view-only links, or to everyone when `public`.

SourceRepo.description:
A repository browsable on the web (GitHub, Gitea, Forgejo, GitLab:
`<repo>/blob/<branch>/<path>#L<line>`).

repo.description: Web URL of the repository, such as `https://github.com/you/trips`.

dir.description: Directory of the site file inside the repository; empty for the root.

PersonalVault.description: A member's personal `KeePass` (`.kdbx`) vault declared on `site.yaml`.

path.description: Path to the `.kdbx` file, relative to `site.yaml`.

owner.description: Member name (matched case-insensitively against trip members).

github.description: Optional explicit GitHub username if not derivable from trip members.
